title: Elf Bar JoinOne Cola Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cola captures the familiar taste of sweet, bubbly Cola with a tangy edge that keeps the flavour bright and refreshing. The blend brings together subtle caramel sweetness and a light sparkle reminiscent of a fresh glass of the real thing, making it a comforting yet lively vape. Each JoinOne Prefilled Pod + Refill arrives ready to use with 2ml pod and 10ml refill container of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and an integrated dual-mesh coil for consistent flavour delivery. Simply assemble then slide into the Mini Battery and snap it onto the larger battery (the one with the HD Screen) adjust the kit’s airflow to suit a tighter or looser mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw. When the pod is empty, simply replace it with a fresh one — no refilling or coil changes required. This pod keeps maintenance simple while offering clean, flavour in a compact format.
